title: Sign in with an injected test session
Chat with May and get a reply
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {platform} chat {tag}, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Chats named for the other platform (Android or iOS) are also listed; never open them. Tap the message field at the bottom. Send this message: This is device test {tag}. Reply with the word received. Then wait until May's reply is posted under your message.

title: Tap a chat reply's notification while that chat is open and scrolled up
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {platform} chat {tag}, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Chats named for the other platform (Android or iOS) are also listed; never open them. Send this message: Reply with the numbers from 1 to 40, one number a line, tag {tag}. Then wait until May's reply shows its numbers. Then swipe down on the conversation, from x=540 y=900 to x=540 y=1900, four times, so that older messages show and the newest are out of view. Then call done with outcome completed. Do not type, tap or send anything else, and do not open the notification shade.

title: Add a note to a new agenda task
goal: In May Playground, tap the Agenda tab in the bottom bar (not a chat). Then read the hierarchy: if the Agenda screen is not showing yet, tap the Agenda tab again at the centre of its own element in the hierarchy, and check again, up to three times, before doing anything else. Do not open any existing task; create a new one. Add a new task titled {tag} task, then open that task. On its Details tab, tap the notes field that says Add notes and type: {tag} note from the device test. Then go back, open the {tag} task again and check that the note is shown on it.

title: Answer May's multiple-choice question
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {platform} chat {tag}, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Chats named for the other platform (Android or iOS) are also listed; never open them. Send this message: Ask me one multiple-choice question about which fruit I would like as a snack, with three choices, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, tap one of the choices. Then wait until that card shows your choice as the answer.

title: Skip May's question with a free reply
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {platform} chat {tag}, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Chats named for the other platform (Android or iOS) are also listed; never open them. Send this message: Ask me one multiple-choice question about which fruit I would like as a snack, with three choices, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, never tap the card or any of its choices, not even to look closer: the only things you tap from here on are the message field and the send button. Instead type and send this message: I will answer myself: apples, {tag}. Then check that the same question card now shows as skipped, with its choices dimmed.

title: Make a routine from chat
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {platform} chat {tag}, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Chats named for the other platform (Android or iOS) are also listed; never open them. Send this message: Make a daily routine called {tag} stretch that reminds me to stretch at 9am. When May shows a question card asking whether to create the routine, tap Create it. Then wait until May confirms the routine is made.

title: Open a For you card's conversation and see its messages at once
goal: In May Playground, tap the For you tab in the bottom bar. Tap the card titled Book the dentist {tag} on its title text, never on its buttons (not Add to Agenda, not Not now). It opens that card's conversation (its header says In May's chat). As soon as that conversation shows, call hierarchy at once: no wait, swipe or screenshot before it. Then swipe up by 10 pixels in the middle of the conversation (from y=1200 to y=1190), and call hierarchy again. Then call done: completed once the conversation has opened, whatever it showed.

title: Go through onboarding on a new account
goal: May Playground has just signed in to a new account for device test {tag} and shows its first-run onboarding. Go through it: on Hi, I'm May tap Accept and continue; on the email step and on the phone step tap Not now, never making an address or getting a number; if the phone step instead says a number is unavailable for this account and offers only Continue, tap Continue there, as test accounts are expected to see that screen; on I have my own computer tap Continue; on Connect your apps tap Not now, never connecting an app; on Make me yours tap Purple, then Continue; on Let me reach you tap Not now, never turning on notifications; on I'm all set, tap Start chatting. Do not type anything or change a setting. You are done, and must stop at once and report success, as soon as you have tapped Not now on Let me reach you, or as soon as the app's main tabs (Chats, Agenda) show, whichever comes first.

title: Harness smoke check: the app starts signed out and the agent can see it
goal: May Playground has just started, signed out. Take one screenshot and read the hierarchy. Do not tap, type, swipe or go back. Then call done with outcome completed, and in the summary name the screen you see.
